liquidity.definition: Fed (WALCL) minus Treasury General Account (WTREGEN) minus overnight reverse repo (RRPONTSYD), plus ECB total assets (ECBASSETSW) and Bank of Japan total assets (JPNASSETS), each converted to US dollars at FRED's own FX (DEXUSEU, DEXJPUS). Month-end observations. Units: US$ trillions.

froth.note: Leveraged ETFs (TQQQ/SOXL/SQQQ) are not in the served universe, so this is the free substitute: Cboe equity put/call (PCCE, 2006+), Nasdaq-100 leadership over the index, and index volume against its own year. Each is a percentile against its own history; 100 = frothiest ever measured here.
